s.note: Pork, fennel and thyme sausage meat rolled in puff pastry with sesame, with tomato sauce
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion, 1 tsp crushed fennel seeds, 1 tsp dried thyme, 30g breadcrumbs and pepper. Halve 2 sheets of puff pastry, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal. Brush with beaten egg, scatter with sesame, cut each into 6, chill for 15 minutes and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.

s.note: Halved eggs piped with mustard yolk cream, dusted with smoked paprika, black sesame and chives
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water for 10 minutes, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp dijon, 1 tsp lemon juice, a pinch of cayenne and salt, and pipe back into the whites. Dust with smoked paprika, black sesame seeds and chopped chives.

m.n: Trainman's dining car chicken and leek pie
m.note: Chicken thigh, leek and thyme in a creamy mustard sauce under golden puff pastry
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in oil, then soften 2 sliced leeks and 2 garlic cloves in 30g butter. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 400ml chicken stock, 150ml cream, 1 tbsp dijon and a tsp of thyme, return the chicken and simmer for 20 minutes. Cool, spoon into a pie dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: Light steamed lemon sponge with a golden syrup top, turned out and served with vanilla custard
w.how: Spoon 4 tbsp golden syrup into a buttered 1.2 litre basin. Cream 125g butter with 125g caster sugar, beat in 2 eggs, fold in 175g self-raising flour, a lemon's zest and 3 tbsp milk, and spoon on top. Cover with pleated baking paper and foil, tie and steam for 90 minutes. Heat 400ml milk with vanilla, pour onto 4 yolks whisked with 50g sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour and stir over low heat until thick. Turn out the pudding and serve with the custard.

d.note: Orange juice and soda over ice with grenadine sunk to the bottom like a sunrise
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Pour in 500ml chilled orange juice and 400ml soda water, then slowly pour 20ml grenadine down the side of each glass so it sinks. Squeeze in a little lime and finish with an orange slice.
